ops.body: Round-9 verdict on a93f14f5: BLOCK, two HIGHs split by KIND. Confirmed sound: the epilogue closes both round-8 races (verifier ran the race tests 15x zero-flake), all eight recorded-flag exits coherent, exception-type independence safety-neutral (restart authority = abort.exists(); nothing branches on the propagated type). HIGH-1 (pre-existing architecture): harness-level kill orphans a billing detached process invisibly — scoped OUT to named pre-A6b blocker task 50d9590 (folds into A7 watchdog); does not block this release (no unattended research-loop consumer until A6b). HIGH-2 (fix now, A3.11): a custom driver's recover_cost raising non-AccountingIntegrityError inside the epilogue's finally REPLACES the propagating exception (reproduced: KeyError swallows CancelledError, zero trace, no latch) — the epilogue boundary becomes TOTAL (any exception from recovery work → latch, nothing re-raised, original exception propagates); Driver protocol docstring documents the contract as a rider. Backlog addition: json_objects RecursionError on pathologically-nested logs (MEDIUM/exotic). ROUND 10 SCOPE PRE-COMMITTED FINAL: V1 totality + no-regression only; new findings outside the release-consumer surface (train/judge/golden/preflight) route to 50d9590 or backlog; clean round 10 = push + release.
